tex_content.html:
Definition

For a positive continuous function $\delta :M\to \mathbb {R}$, maps $F,\widetilde F:M\to \mathbb {R}^k$ are $\delta $-close if \[ |F(x)-\widetilde F(x)|<\delta (x) \qquad \text{for every }x\in M. \]
